question: Where can I locate hotel inside 50 kilometers on the route leading from Hickory Grove Riverfront, Cary, IL to In the Game - Hollywood Park, Crestwood, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hickory Grove Riverfront%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cary%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%In the Game - Hollywood Park%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Crestwood%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 50000 ) );
